definitions.gloss: the way home; return journey; homeward path
definitions.explanation: The route or journey back to one's home or starting point. A somewhat formal or literary word often used in written narratives and news.

examples.japanese: {帰路|きろ}の{途中|とちゅう}で{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: It started raining on the way home.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{出張|しゅっちょう}を{終|お}えて{帰路|きろ}についたとき、ほっとした。
examples.english: I felt relieved when I finally headed home after a long business trip.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat formal word. The set phrase {帰路|きろ}につく (to set out for home, to head home) is the most common usage. Often appears in written narratives, travel writing, and news reports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {帰路|きろ}につく (to head home)
- {帰路|きろ}の{途中|とちゅう} (on the way home)
- {帰路|きろ}を{急|いそ}ぐ (to hurry home)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {帰|かえ}り{道|みち}: the way home — everyday, casual equivalent
- {復路|ふくろ}: return trip — more formal, used for round-trip travel
